part: Running gear of the speedrun chassis: wheel suspension (front C-hubs with steering knuckles, rear hub carriers), axles with hex hubs, CVD drive shafts, steering (posts, bellcranks, links), servo with the floating servo mount, dampers and sway bars. Own design of the owner, re-engineered from the Carten T410R and deviating from it where the function requires; not verified. Files: cad/running_gear, generated with scripts/cad/generate_running_gear.py.
coordinate_system: Chassis plate coordinates (assembly): x across the car (+x right side seen toward End A), y along the car (End B at y = 0, End A front), z = 0 bottom face of the chassis plate. The parts of the right side are built and mirrored to the left side (x -> -x).

source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual (design principle, sizes of screws, pins and bearings)
source_codes.derived: Calculated from other parts of the model
source_codes.design: Design choice for the function (own design, not measured)

ride_height.note: Ride height front (End A) and rear (End B), setup sheet 4: axle heights 22.0 and 17.0 above the bottom face of the chassis plate.

wheel_centre_x.note: Wheel centre plane: overall width 190 over the tyres (30 mm wide), owner.

caster.note: Caster of the front kingpins (setup sheet 4), top toward the middle of the car.

kingpin_x.note: Front kingpin axis at the height of the axle; the centre of the outer CVD joint lies on it.

front_c_hub.note: Front C-hub: back plate from x to x, radius of the passage of the CVD drive shaft (bone 4.0 and the joint cup of the axle at full steering angle), axial clearance to the knuckle at the top and the bottom (along the kingpin axis), thickness of the upper arm (square to the kingpin axis), top of the back plate (seat of the camber ball stud, z). The caster of 10 degrees is in the C-hub: the kingpin bores and the faces toward the knuckle are square to the tilted kingpin axis, so the knuckle turns with a constant clearance.

front_c_hub_width.note: Width (y) of the C-hub: lower arm and back plate below z = 10.5 (between the rails of the wishbone, inner faces +-6.2), back plate above z = 10, upper arm (square to the kingpin axis). The lug on the outer hinge pin is 13.0 long (outer gap of the wishbone 13.3).

knuckle.note: Front steering knuckle, built in the frame of the kingpin axis (origin in the centre of the outer CVD joint): bottom and top along the kingpin axis, radius of the pivot body around the kingpin (0.5 clear of the back plate of the C-hub at every steering angle), radius of the bearing housing (from 1.0 behind the kingpin axis), width of the web (y). Kingpin bores 3.1 (the knuckle turns on the pins), joint space 11.2, bearing seats 10.0.

steering_arm_ball.note: Steering arm of the knuckle: x of the ball stud, y relative to the kingpin axis (toward the middle of the car), top face of the arm along the kingpin axis relative to the axle centre (the arm lies below the CVD joint, thickness 3.0), half width of the arm at the kingpin. Chosen with the ball arm of the bellcrank (forward, 14.0) for a steering link nearly perpendicular to both arms and an Ackermann of approx. 75 to 90 %. The ball stud is screwed in along the kingpin axis.

rear_carrier.note: Rear hub carrier (in the frame of the rear arm: x along the arm from the outer hinge pin): web from x to x, top (z); lower lug between 2 spacers 3x7x3 on the outer hinge pin.

axle.note: Axles: diameter in the bearings 5x10x4 (manual), thread M4 at the end for the wheel nut, outer diameter and length of the joint cup.

hex_hub.note: Hex hubs 12 mm (spec_tires.yaml), width front and rear (manual: 6 and 7 mm), pin 2x10 through the axle in a slot of the hub, grub screw M3x3.

cvd.note: CVD drive shafts: bone diameter, end balls, cross pins 2x8 in the slots of the outdrive cups and of the joint cups of the axles.

post.note: Steering posts on H24/H25 (owner): hexagon 5.5 across the flats, height of the hexagon, journal 5.0 for 2 bearings 5x8x2.5; thread M3 at both ends (screw from below through the chassis plate, screw with washer on top).

bellcrank.note: Bellcranks as the T410R (manual steps 13 and 14): straight levers on the posts; bottom and top (z), length of the ball arm (forward, toward End A), offset of its ball toward the middle of the car (-1.0: ball at x = +-20.7, on the line of the inner hinge pins against bump steer), length of the rear arm to the bridge. The ball arm moves the ball of the steering link across the car. Ball stud on top (thread M3), bearings 5x8x2.5 on the posts.

bridge.note: Rigid steering bridge as the T410R (manual step 13): bottom (z: 1.0 above the centre driveshaft), thickness, width, depth of the boss behind the bridge with the thread M3 for the ball stud of the servo link (stud toward End B). The bridge joins the rear arms of the bellcranks behind the posts and moves across the car; it turns on 2 spacers (collar 7.0 from the bellcrank to the bridge, sleeve 5.0 in the bridge), screws M3x18 into the bellcranks.

servo.note: Servo (spec_servo.yaml, low profile): length, width, height incl. output spline. Mounted as the T410R (manual step 10): across the car, output shaft and horn facing forward (End A), output at the outer end of the case; the case starts at x = 12.5 (beside the centre driveshaft). Servo mount on H17/H21 (owner): base plate with an upright behind each ear.

servo_horn.note: Clamp servo horn (aluminium, 25T, no servo saver: spec_servo.yaml): length to the ball stud (vertical in the centre position, manual step 10), width, thickness. The ball moves across the car and pushes the bridge through the servo link (gap 21, manual: B).

damper.note: Standard 1:10 on-road damper: body diameter, cap diameter, spring diameter, shaft diameter, body length, spring wire.

sway_bar.note: Sway bars as the T410R (manual step 23, photos of the owner): wire 1.4, height of the bar in the holders (z), position of the holders outside the screw holes of the tabs of the lower bulkhead (y in the coordinates of the bulkhead), half length of the straight part in the holders. From there the legs run outward to the arms (trapezoid in the plan view).

sway_lever.note: Legs of the sway bars (front, rear): height after the first bend (z: the front leg passes below the diff outdrives and above the pivot block, the rear leg below the CVD drive shaft), height of the bend into the cup, tilt of the cup on the ball stud of the arm toward the middle of the car (degrees, as in the photos of the owner).

ball_offset.note: Ball studs: centre of the ball 4.0 from the face of the part (neck 3.0, thread M3 into the part).

damper_plane.note: Dampers in the plane 8.3 in front of the damper face of the shock towers (spring collar 15.0 plus 0.8); the lower ball stud along the hole of the shock plate reaches this plane.

steering_lock.note: Required steering angle of the front knuckles in both directions; the generator reports the free angle (no contact of the knuckle, the axle and the steering arm with the C-hub, the CVD drive shaft and the wishbone).
